## About
Gold Seal Painting is owned by Robert, a local business owner, not a big brand franchise. We're based on Lambert St in Leander and do interior and exterior custom painting for homes around the Austin area.
Our goal is simple: clean, fast, quality work, and a customer who's happy with how it turned out. Robert keeps his work area tidy, pays attention to the details and goes back over spots for touch up.
We have a 5 star Google rating from 24 reviews. Give us a call and let us know what we can do for your painting needs.

## Services
- Interior & Exterior: Custom painting inside and out. Customers have had ceilings, walls and trim done, plus doors, shutters and even a large barn shed.
- Kitchen cabinets: One customer had their kitchen cabinets done in a much lighter color.
- Fence staining: Robert has handled fence staining as part of getting a home ready to sell.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us and Robert will check out your project and give you a free estimate.

Q: What area do you serve?
A: We're based in Leander and serve the Austin area.

Q: How quickly will I hear back?
A: Send a message through our contact form and you'll usually hear back quickly. Our site lists an average response within 1 hour.

Robert was a pleasure to have around the house. He was always friendly, professional, and kept his work area clean and organized throughout the project. I’m very particular about details, and he was always patient with my requests and happy to make sure everything was done the way I wanted.
